description: This file implements a synchronous host resolver for the QUIC protocol, utilizing a dedicated thread to perform DNS resolution asynchronously.

classes.name: ResolverThread
classes.description: A thread class responsible for performing DNS resolution asynchronously.

methods.name: ResolverThread::Resolve
methods.description: Initiates DNS resolution on the resolver thread and waits for completion.

methods.name: ResolverThread::Run
methods.description: Executes the DNS resolution logic within the thread.

methods.name: ResolverThread::OnResolutionComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of DNS resolution.

methods.name: SynchronousHostResolver::Resolve
methods.description: Static method to perform synchronous DNS resolution using ResolverThread.
